title: CNBC Squawk Box — Eric on building business in the AI age and his push to end quarterly earnings
summary: CNBC books Eric for a launch-week Squawk Box segment on building businesses in the AI age, corporate governance, and his SEC petition to end quarterly earnings reporting — the first time the SEC has reconsidered the rule in 40 years.
blockquote: 'Incorruptible' author Eric Ries on building business in the AI age, push to end quarterly earnings
